name: Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbone
summary: Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones are durable skeletal trophies gathered from the renegade Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands. Required by armor crafter Velora Nitely in the Undercity, they serve as reinforcement struts for bespoke warrior armor.

sections.title: Bones for the Frame
sections.body: When forging brutal leg guards for frontline warriors, smiths require raw components that can endure severe punishment. In the Undercity, Velora Nitely prizes the skeletal density of the renegade Dragonmaw orcs entrenched at the Angerfang Encampment in the northern Wetlands. Dragonmaw orcs are known for their thick, sturdy frames, making their shins well suited to serve as structural bracers. However, not every collected bone can withstand the strain; warriors must test each piece with their bare hands, discarding those that snap under pressure.

faq.q: What makes these shinbones sturdy compared to normal ones?
faq.answer: Dragonmaw orcs possess naturally thick skeletal frames, but minor fractures or brittle bone make many samples useless for forging armor. To confirm one is sturdy, a warrior bends the raw bone with their bare hands; only those that resist breaking are considered strong enough to frame protective leg guards.
Velora Nitely, an armorer located in the Undercity, seeks them out. She uses them as core framing struts when crafting brutal leg guards for promising Horde warriors.
They are taken from the renegade Dragonmaw orcs occupying the Wetlands south of the Arathi Highlands, most notably at the Angerfang Encampment nestled in the hills southwest of the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why does Velora Nitely use orc bones for armor?
faq.answer: Forsaken craftsmanship frequently integrates bone, sinew, and metal into morbid yet highly durable wargear. The Dragonmaw clan remains hostile to Thrall's Horde, making their remains fair game for Forsaken smiths looking for resilient, heavy-duty crafting material.

angles.text: Procuring and testing these dense orc bones with bare hands proves a warrior's physical might while gathering the framing pieces for custom armor.
Velora Nitely represents typical Forsaken pragmatism, repurposing the bones of their enemies into functional equipment for the Dark Lady's champions.
